messages:
Rowan (product): Internal GA notice: Hosted Pipeline v5 is now live internally and starting regional rollout. This introduces /v5/pipeline as the canonical endpoint for combined streaming, tool orchestration, and structured events. Docs & migration: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/pipeline-v5

Felix (eng-runtime): Summary: - single endpoint: POST /v5/pipeline - stream + tool orchestration in one flow - structured frames include kind: token|tool_request|tool_result|metric - lightweight capabilities frame at start so clients can adapt

Noor (infra): Rollout plan: canary in us-east-2, then eu-west-2, ap-southeast-1. Rolling over 18h. Observability added: pipeline.event_rate and pipeline.tool_exec_rate metrics. Keep an eye on error_rate and P95 token latency.

Jin (devex): SDKs: @redwood/sdk-js v5.0.0 and @redwood/sdk-py v5.0.0 add pipelineClient.streamPipeline() helper and automatic frame parsing. Please update quickstarts and example repos.

Marta (security): Policy change: tool orchestration is OFF for new orgs; enabling requires org admin + compliance contact and an audit-email set in Console. This prevents accidental execution during broad rollout. Existing org settings unchanged.

Rowan (product): New per-request header to control behavior: X-RW-Pipeline-Mode: evented|raw and X-RW-Tool-Consent: org|request|force. Example: curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v5/pipeline -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-RW-Pipeline-Mode: evented' -d '{"model":"rwd-pipeline-1","input":"Inspect repo","stream":true,"functions":[{"name":"list","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'

Felix (eng-runtime): Important: per-request tool consent still requires the org to be enabled for tool execution. If consent is given but org is not enabled, the stream emits a tool_blocked frame and audit log entry.

DeployBot: rollout:hosted-pipeline-v5 -> canary:us-east-2 ✅ started at 1799999999, est complete 1800006500.

Noor (infra): Quick troubleshooting tips: - If you see TOOL_BLOCKED events, check org settings in Console -> Security. - Use Model-Alias header to pin variants if you need a specific quantization.

Jin (devex): Action items: 1) bump example repos to SDK v5.0.0, 2) add sample showing X-RW-Tool-Consent usage, 3) update tutorials. Reply when done.

Rowan (product): TL;DR: v5 pipeline GA internal rollout: consolidated endpoint, structured frames, SDK 5.0.0, org-level opt-in for tools, new headers. Thanks all — please monitor support and escalate any >2x latency jumps to #eng-sre.
